description: Fetch full details of a single Pinterest Pin (an image or video post) by URL or Pin id. Returns title, description, full-resolution image (or HLS playlist URL for video Pins), outbound source link, creator, reaction/comment counts. Pass --include_comments true to also load comments, and --related_limit N to also return N related Pins from the "More like this" section. Requires a logged-in browser session.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Pin URL (https://www.pinterest.com/pin/<id>/) or a bare numeric Pin id. Pin URLs appear in the output of search, get-feed, get-board and get-user.

parameters.name: include_comments
parameters.description: Set to true to also return the Pin's comments. Default false. Comments lazy-load, so enabling this makes the command slower.

parameters.name: comment_limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of comments to return (1-100, default 20). Only used when include_comments is true.

parameters.name: related_limit
parameters.description: Number of related Pins to also return (0-50, default 0 = disabled). Related Pins are the "More like this" recommendations below the Pin.
